decisions.reason: The transactional email service is the firm's flagship and fits rising cloud messaging demand, so the option is moving toward full commitment rather than abandonment.

Email-to-fax conversion runs on existing infrastructure at little cost and still serves regulated German customers in healthcare and the public sector, so holding the option remains cheap and worthwhile.
As a low-cost feature close to the core fax service, it adds value to that offering and there is no evidence that its value has failed to materialize.
Sandbox threat protection matches the sharply growing demand for email security since 2020 and strengthens the firm's security positioning, so the option looks increasingly valuable.
Multi-engine scanning is a cheap extension of the email security suite, and the worst case is bundling it into other offerings rather than outright withdrawal.
